I replied to Hollis in a thread on his #central-random message: the ticket is #88412.

That's the Tier 2 escalation for the Door 6 gatehouse tablet at Tansleigh Packaging (account code TSP) freezing on the bill of lading (BOL) barcode scan. Tobias raised it in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025, and in the same thread he confirmed it was Tansleigh, not Tansley Parcel. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so he can see that himself.

I found a separate Door 6 issue (ticket #4912, a lock at the Marietta plant), but only in an email Hollis may not have received. It's a different problem, so I left it out of the reply.
